subject: general
question: The Kashi Yatra Scheme was introduced by the government of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 1**__**.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Karnataka government launching a scheme called** 'Kashi Yatra'** that provides cash assistance for pilgrims to the **Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The** Kashi Yatra project,** which offers a cash assistance o**f Rs. 5,000 to each of the 30,000 pilgrims** willing to conduct a pilgrimage to the Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The Kashi Yatra scheme was only recently proposed by the government in the **2022–23 budget, and it was quickly authorized by the Karnataka government in late June.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Karnataka is a state located in the southwestern region of India.**
 
• It is bordered by the states of **Maharashtra to the north, Goa to the northwest**, **Andhra Pradesh to the east**, **Tamil Nadu to the southeast, and Kerala to the southwest.**
 
• **The Arabian Sea **also borders the** state to the west.**
 
• The capital city of Karnataka is Bengaluru, which is located in the southeastern part of the state.
